groups.title: LM Eval PCP
groups.assessment: An exact source/extension-matched TP2xPCP2 PCP-only run reached AITER MXFP4/MLA, loaded all 282 shards, and allocated 158.33 GiB of KV cache per rank on 4xMI355. All four ranks then hit native GPU memory-access faults during 1,024-token warmup before API readiness. This rules out source/binary mismatch; PCP+EP remains blocked behind the simpler failure.

groups.title: LM Eval Spec Decode
groups.assessment: Meaningful partial coverage: a locally validated MI355_4 TP4+EP fixed-length DSpark job uses FP8 indexer/KV caches and passed all 1,319 GSM8K cases at 0.9484 accuracy with 4.448 mean accepted tokens. Exact CUDA parity remains open because Blackwell MXFP4 indexer caching and adaptive verification require ROCm capabilities not yet present.
